Name: pooled-training
The server receives: the model trained on the shuffled union

Name: served-model
Accepts: a dataset from each client, queries
The querier receives: the trained model's answer to each query

Name: fedavg-plain
Accepts: a dataset or any update from each client, a model for each client each round from the server
The server receives: every client's update in every round

Name: fedavg-secagg
The server receives: the sum of the updates in every round

Name: fedavg-final
Accepts: a dataset or any update from each client
A client receives: the average model of every round

Name: split-learning
Accepts: batches from the client, any gradient at the cut from the server
The server receives: the activations at the cut and the labels

Name: vertical-training
Accepts: a feature block of the shared records from each client, the labels and any gradient from the server
A client receives: the gradient at its own embedding

Name: private-inference
Accepts: a model from the server, a query
The querier receives: the model's answer to the query

Name: he-oft
Accepts: a dataset, or any head displacement and per-class counts, from each client, up to $Q$ queries~\cite{KSK26}
The server receives: each client's sample count and the selected arrangement
